categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Prulde Electric Appliance Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of electric tools. Its product portfolio includes seven major series: electric heating, spraying, blowing and suction, nail guns, impact grinding, power supply, and others, with nearly 400 specifications. The company operates both ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) and OBM (Own Branding Manufacturing) business models, serving international brands and developing its own brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation with a strong R&D team and has developed key components such as motors, battery packs, and PCB controls in-house. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including automated assembly lines, digital twin factories, intelligent warehousing, MES and WMS systems to build a smart factory. The company holds over 518 patents and participates in national and industry standards formulation, focusing on lithium battery-powered cordless tools and smart, high-efficiency products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Prulde serves numerous international well-known electric tool brands and retailers including Stanley Black & Decker, Bosch, Makita, Einhell, ADEO, Kingfisher, Harbor Freight Tools, Lowe's, and Hikoki/Metabo. Its products are widely used in home renovation, industrial manufacturing, construction, and garden maintenance. The company’s products are exported to nearly 100 countries and regions across Europe, America, and Asia-Pacific, with growing sales through cross-border e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Zhejiang and Thailand, and sales networks covering Europe, the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and other global markets. It has overseas subsidiaries including Batavia B.V. in Europe and Prulde Electric Appliance (Thailand) Co., Ltd. The company leverages cross-border e-commerce platforms such as Tmall, Amazon, Walmart, Temu, and TikTok to expand its international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Prulde operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric tools supply chain. It undertakes R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales of finished electric tools and key components. The company has vertically integrated capabilities for critical parts like motors, battery packs, and PCB controls, enhancing supply chain resilience and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation in lithium battery-powered cordless tools, smart and high-efficiency electric tools, and expanding its own brand portfolio. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 33.76% increase in R&D expenditure in 2024, and actively develops new products such as high-flow cyclone vacuum cleaners, intelligent heat guns, and advanced nail guns. Collaborations with universities and overseas experts support technology breakthroughs and product upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electric tools and components to international brand customers and end consumers via both offline and online channels. The company operates an ODM model supplying branded customers and an OBM model promoting its own brands through global e-commerce platforms. Sales are recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with a significant portion from exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Prulde is positioned as a competitive professional manufacturer in China's electric tools industry, recognized for its technical innovation and quality. It ranks first in domestic sales for heat gun products for five consecutive years and maintains strong partnerships with leading global brands. The company is transitioning from OEM/ODM to a technology-driven brand leader, aiming to compete with international first-tier brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 872 million, a 22.27% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 63 million, a 19.87% decrease due to increased expenses from brand development and acquisitions. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.5 billion, showing stable growth. R&D investment increased by 33.76%, supporting long-term growth and product diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Prulde emphasizes advanced technology, product quality, and comprehensive service as its core value proposition. It differentiates through in-house development of key components, extensive patent portfolio, smart manufacturing, and adherence to international quality certifications (GS, CE, UL, ETL, SAA, KC). The company offers a broad product range tailored to diverse customer needs from DIY to industrial-grade tools, supported by strong global sales and after-sales networks.
